scope: Read-only comparison of retained native-grid HMC resampled 490-frame intermediate images from old FNIT c3c921cc and official fMRIPrep25.2.4. HMC estimators, reference images and interpolation kernels are independently selected. No EPI/T1 or T1/MNI transformation is applied at this stage. Different reference contents limit attribution to estimation error alone.
signal: native HMC only, before intensity normalization and denoising

mask.kind: intersection of independently produced native functional brain masks

intensity_comparison: Original float32 output intensities; no scale normalization, regression fit, smoothing or intensity offset adjustment is applied.
limits: One real run; no accuracy or speed claim over other subjects.
HMC images use independently estimated motion and different reference contents; this is not a common-transform sampling control.
Old FNIT HMC estimator is masked Pearson/Adam35-25-15; official MCFLIRT plus cubic grid-constant resampling. Latest merged FNIT MCFLIRT is measured separately.
Both retained native HMC output images and masks share the same 88x88x64 grid and affine; no new fit or resampling is performed by this observer.
No denoised clean BOLD is compared with reference preproc.
FreeSurfer 7 reference upgrade inherited autorecon1; structural timing is reported separately.
privacy: Only aggregate statistics, shapes and SHA-256; no images, voxel values, private paths or identifiers.
